title: Plainly
objective: Fill in the label plainly: your name and a shared future, with no conditions and no speech.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna has the wooden label out before you reach her. Its corners have gone round from living in her apron.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “The seed hasn’t come up. It’s a three-year seed. I check it anyway.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She holds out the label and the pencil from her bun.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “It has to fit on the label.”

options.labelText: “My name goes in the space. Marry me, and we’ll both be there when it flowers.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She writes your name in the space, spelled right on the first try. She checks it twice anyway.

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Yes. Obviously. You only had to say it at label size.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tucks the label into the apron pocket nearest her heart. She has measured which one that is.

options.labelText: “Marry me once the infirmary can spare you. I don’t mind waiting until things calm down.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “It won’t. Someone sprains something every day. I keep a chart.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The label goes back in her apron. On the way, she checks the space, in case your name has turned up by itself.
